title: CALM-IT: Enhancing Synthetic Motivational Interviewing Dialogue Quality with Conversational Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2601.10085v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conversational dynamics describe how rapport, emotion, and goals change over a dialogue. These changes are important in therapeutic conversations, where they can influence when and how therapists intervene. However, large language model (LLM)-based synthetic therapeutic dialogue generators rarely track how these properties evolve together, which may limit the quality of longer conversations. We introduce CALM-IT, a dual-agent framework that tracks client states and therapist-side inferences to guide strategy selection and utterance generation. We evaluate synthetic Motivational Interviewing (MI) dialogues using automated Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) ratings, conversational metrics, and comparisons across dialogue lengths, with ratings from four licensed psychologists providing support for key findings. translated_title: CALM-IT：通过会话动态提升合成动机式访谈对话质量
translated_abstract: 会话动态描述了融洽关系、情绪和目标在对话过程中如何随时间变化。这些变化在治疗性对话中至关重要，因为它们会影响治疗师介入的时机和方式。然而，基于大语言模型（LLM）的合成治疗性对话生成器很少追踪这些属性如何共同演变，这可能限制了较长对话的质量。我们提出了CALM-IT，这是一个双智能体框架，通过追踪来访者状态和治疗师侧的推断来指导策略选择与话语生成。我们使用自动化的动机式访谈治疗完整性（MITI）评分、会话指标以及不同对话长度下的比较来评估合成的动机式访谈（MI）对话，四位持证心理学家的评分为主要发现提供了支持。在涵盖686个真实场景、四个框架和三种目标长度的8,232个对话中，CALM-IT...
tldr: 提出双智能体框架CALM-IT，通过追踪来访者状态与治疗师侧推断来建模会话动态变化，从而显著提升长篇合成动机式访谈治疗对话的质量。
en_tdlr: CALM-IT is a dual-agent framework that enhances synthetic Motivational Interviewing dialogue quality by modeling conversational dynamics through tracking client states and therapist-side inferences.
